inlines.text: 이 페이지는 생산·건설·보관·수리 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(conservation-with-optional-admitted-quality-contest): Bottleneck min of required channel ratios; positive denominators; floor only completed batch, retain residual. Quality contest never invents input/output quantity; recipe accounts for atoms.

blocks.text:
inclusive-cutoff [bounded-symbolic-contract] verifiedArrival && arrivalAt <= cutoff
material-conservation [bounded-symbolic-contract] unusedAfter + consumedAfter = unusedBefore + consumedBefore; progressAfter = progressBefore on interruption
reservation-limit [bounded-symbolic-contract] sum(reserved same-item atoms) <= verified available same-item atoms
D05-F1 [후보·승인 전] advance=min(each availableInput/inputPerBatch,work/workPerBatch,energy/energyPerBatch,facilityCap,storageCap); completed=floor(carryProgress+advance); progress=carryProgress+advance-completed
D05-F2 [후보·승인 전] consumed+unused conserved on interruption; recipe must account for input atoms in output,workInProgress,waste; storage reservation before output stage

inlines.text: D05의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: material quantities — nonnegative integer atoms tagged with itemId and unit (item-specific atom)
work/progress — nonnegative exact rational (recipe-specific work unit)
rates/power/duration/facility/storage — nullable unit-tagged recipe specification (item/work/power per named clock interval; capacity in item atoms)
reservedDemand/consumed/unused — nonnegative exact integer (same item atoms)
resultId/actorId/ownerId/version — identity string / nonnegative version integer (identity / revision)
arrivalAt/cutoff — finite numeric documentary clock coordinate (same supplied world clock unit)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 D05 생산·단계·경제 효과 정산; D13 소유권, D02 신체 상태, D18 시간·저장, 유지 계약은 inclusive-cutoff·material-conservation·reservation-limit다. 상태 소유 경계는 recipe version,required channels,arrival receipts,available/reserved atoms,consumed,WIP,waste,output,residual,storage reservation. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_CONSERVATION, E_INPUT, E_UNIT
기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_FIELDS, E_INTEGER, E_ID, E_UNKNOWN, E_RATIO, E_FACILITY, E_RESULTS, E_RESERVATION, E_KIND

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

items.text: BigInt bottleneck min/floor/residual only, required channels selected by caller, no resources/recipe mutation
Number bottleneck candidate, no exact authoritative conservation

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D05-recipe-bottleneck-transaction(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/recipe-bottleneck-transaction.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/recipe-bottleneck-transaction.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
